reviews.comment: He's kind of dull in lectures but he posts slides and you don't need to know much more than that for exams. He doesn't give all the equations on the exams, so memorize some. The homework can be long sometimes. He's super nice and good at explaining things in class or office hours if you need. There's a big group project at the end of the semester.

The sweetest professor ever, you can tell he loves what he teaches and wants everyone to pass. As long as you do the homework and have a decent final project you will be okay. Just make sure to do good on the first two exams because the final was a lot more difficult.

Zhang is very friendly and has a lot of passion for the subject. There is one group project which was pretty enjoyable and the difficulty of his exams are reasonable. My only grievance is that we didn't do many examples in class which would've made the homework easier. Other than that, there were no issues.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was super interesting. Be prepared he takes a picture of the class so he knows who has been coming and makes a seating chart. Exams were my downfall on the workout, but as long as you practice the workout and memorize all the terms you will be fine. He does a jeopardy game before the exams and that has a lot of the info you need to know.

Dr. Zhang was a solid prof. Nice guy and his class wasn't too difficult. There were 7 total homework assignments, none of which were too difficult. 2 midterms and a final. His exams were pretty simple; didn't try to trick you or overcomplicate it. If you go to class and do the homework, you should do just fine in his class.
